productOnPage.description: From the Creator: Sing, play, and learn with the best of Wee Sing! A fun-filled mix of classic songs, lullabies, and action tunes that inspire movement, learning, and family sing-alongs. Sing along with the very best of Wee Sing! Packed with beloved favorites like “Bingo,” “Down by the Bay,” and “Skidamarink,” this joyful collection is made for singing, dancing, laughing, and making memories together. From playful action songs to gentle lullabies, these timeless tunes encourage kids to join in, move their bodies, and use their imaginations. Whether it’s playtime at home, a family road trip, or winding down before bed, there’s something here for every moment. Loved by generations of families, Wee Sing has helped children learn and grow through music for decades — and these classic songs are ready to become part of your family’s soundtrack too. Tracks included: The More Wee Sing Together If You're Happy Skidamarink Bingo Do Your Ears Hang Low? Goes the Weasel Polly Wolly Doodle Hickory, Dickory, Dock Ring Around the Rosy The Hokey Pokey Teddy Bear Who Built the Ark? Rain, Rain, Go Away There Is Thunder It's Raining Sing-a-Ling He's Got the Whole World Hush, Little Baby Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star The More Wee Sing Together (Reprise)
